sample_unit: patient case vignettes (3 runs each, 90 run-level outputs)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT treatment recommendations across three repeated runs
links.effect: Complete agreement across repeated runs in 61 of 90 case-guideline combinations (67.8%); 23 of 90 outputs (25.6%) discordant at run level.
links.quote: Complete agreement across repeated runs occurred in 61 of 90 case-guideline combinations (67.8%).

links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT postoperative GI cancer recommendations with German guidelines
links.effect: 21 of 30 cases (70%) fully concordant; pancreatic and gastric 80% each, colorectal 50%; 14 of 90 run-level outputs (15.6%) major deviations.
links.quote: ChatGPT-generated majority-vote recommendations were fully concordant with German guideline-based recommendations in 21 of 30 cases (70%).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's concordance with guidelines and tumor board recommendations on retrospective clinical vignettes without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice variation.
